svg.aria-label: FIEZEL — Splash Storyboard v3 · “PARTICLE FORMATION + PAW STAMP ON MULAI” (§1S-v3 BINDING · OWNER ruling 2026-08-28 · supersedes storyboard-splash-v2)
svg.text: FIEZEL — Splash Storyboard v3 · “PARTICLE FORMATION + PAW STAMP ON MULAI” (§1S-v3 BINDING · OWNER ruling 2026-08-28 · supersedes storyboard-splash-v2)

one clock (FZSplash.clock) · 0–950 F formation · 700–1150 bar gathering · 1150–1900 equalizer · 1900–2100 settle+welcome · Mulai→stamp ≤1400 ms · pitches F2 F3 C4 F4 A4 C5 G5 + thud + eq-tick · NO MASCOT (m025-80) · NO SHEEN/HALO/GLOW (OA-5)

g.text: point-cloud from frame 1 — gold #F0C241/#FFD94F + cream dots
NO glow / bloom / halo — sheen DELETED (OA-5)

svg.text: phase SCATTER — futuristic, not linear tweens

g.text: particles converge on F targets — stem earlier than arms
targets sampled from the real SVG rects

svg.text: SFX: F3 @300 · C4 @520 ride the convergence

g.text: F snaps + crossfades to the crisp SVG layer (≤120 ms)
THE ORDERING BEAT: solid F, bars still dots

svg.text: SFX: F4 @950 as the F locks
F first — bars still particles (OWNER beat)
gate V3-G2: crisp F while bars sub-solid

g.text: A4 = the colour tone: gold turns SOLID +
major third on the same frame (signature kept)
bars bounce like an audio equalizer — scaleY only, pivot bottom
wordmark reveals bottom 1200–1500 — small per v2

svg.text: SFX: C5 @~1400 · eq-tick accents on beats

g.text: equalizer.settle() → bars at EXACT logo proportions
welcome card crossfades in — logo persists above
splash RESTS here: no auto-exit, no auto-slam

svg.text: SFX: G5 @1900 — add9 rings under the card
autonomous motion ends 2100 · zero ambient anim
close-timer model RETIRED — user holds the key

g.text: USER PRESSES MULAI — the stamp is the user's act now
anticipation 240 ms: glyph raised, scale 1.16, card dims
NO halo flare — deleted with the sheen (OA-5)

svg.text: SFX: STAMP THUD — F2 sub 110→48 Hz + noise
same v2 slam identity, now Mulai-triggered
audible event = visible landing, same frame

g.text: seal settles −6° ink-spread → stamp EXPANDS as the transition
press → onboarding visible ≤ 1400 ms — no dead time

svg.text: SFX: thud tail decays (≤300 ms) — then quiet
the expanding stamp IS the exit — no fade beat

Particles: gold #F0C241/#FFD94F + cream #FFF4DA dots 1–2.5px, ~1400–2200 adaptive (low-end: ~500–700 → static formation fallback, §1S-v3.8) · targets sampled from the real SVG geometry · no glow/bloom/shadowBlur anywhere.

Paw glyph = assets/brand/fiezel-paw.svg EXACT geometry (4 toe bars rx1.55 + heel pad), splash gold recolor #FFDE59→#FFC700→#E6A800 (§1S.7) — slam plays ONLY on the Mulai press; same v2 slam + SFX identity (thud F2 sub 110→48Hz + noise).

Wordmark unchanged from v2: min(30vw,132px) small at the bottom · skip = tap pre-welcome jumps to the welcome card (no auto-exit to race) · reduced motion = static formed comp; Mulai → stamped glyph fades in, no slam (§1S-v3.6).
